parameters.query:
SELECT id, name, city, category, status, website_score, enrichment_score, email,
  enrichment->>'instagram_url' AS instagram, enrichment->>'facebook_url' AS facebook,
  coalesce(landing_html, '') <> '' AS has_page,
  to_char(sent_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata', 'DD Mon HH24:MI') AS sent_time
FROM leads
WHERE (processed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date = $1::date
  AND ($2 = 'all' OR status = $2)
ORDER BY enrichment_score DESC NULLS LAST, id;
UPDATE leads SET status = 'rejected' WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) RETURNING id;
SELECT id, name, category, address, phone, enrichment::text AS enrichment FROM leads WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]);
UPDATE leads SET landing_html = $2, status = 'ready_to_send' WHERE id = $1::int;
INSERT INTO outreach (lead_id, channel, status, to_address, message) VALUES ($1::int, $2, $3, $4, $5);
UPDATE outreach SET status = 'done', done_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) RETURNING id;
